requiredClientIntegrationSteps.instruction: Verify the selected artifact SHA-256 and source commit against this handoff manifest before integrating it.
Install the exact .tgz as @bitwarden/sdk-internal, keep the existing WASM initialization path, and remove any client-local alias lifecycle or alias-reference implementation.
Extract the Swift archive, consume its BitwardenSdk package and BitwardenFFI.xcframework together, and remove any separately generated alias bindings.
Place the versioned JAR and matching host native library on the same runtime path, then remove any separately generated alias bindings.
Add the versioned AAR as the sole Android SDK binary and remove any separately generated alias bindings or native libraries.
Persist only current-schema alias references created and parsed by the SDK; reject unsupported schemas and do not infer bindings from usernames or addresses.
Use the provider commit recorded in providerPin when reproducing the real SimpleLogin lifecycle gate.
